newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index continues recovery.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index continues recovery.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index again moved higher last week with a gain of 33 points or 1.0 percent. The All Ordinaries Index rose 1.82 percent. Changes, in percent:
May 30 May 33 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

"The Eyres Reed Explorer Index continued its cautious recovery after the March/April shakeout," Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary, noting the 33 point rise in was the fourth consecutive weekly rise in the index.
Strong performers included Border Gold NL which closed the week at 29 cents, up from 21.5 at the close last week, on encouraging indications from its French Kiss gold prospect at Karonie.

Jubilee Gold Mines NL rose from 17.5 to 21 cents, helped by the fact its lease adjoints the Yakabindie nickel project. Moonstone Diamond Corp NL, Sovereign Resources (Australia) NL and Victoria Petroleum NL also posted solid gains for the week.

Falls included Walhalla Mining Co NL, which fell 4.5 cents to 23.5 cents, Marymia Exploration NL, which dropped 4.4 to 25.5, Nugold Hill Mines NL, down 1.5 at 13.5, and Arboyne NL, down 2.5 at 22.5 cents.
